scope: All24 user-requested local implementation goals, without changing original production acceptance criteria
verification_rule: Close an item only with authoritative current source and complete matching-scope local implementation/runtime evidence; dated scoped passes do not imply whole-system acceptance.

items.title: Roster browser-reload recovery
items.local_acceptance: Implement144 server/client recovery with session-bound reference-only browser storage, exact serialized payload hashes, bounded private drafts/intents, explicit save/recovery/resumption, request replay, expiry/purge and CAS conflict tests. No private rows, reasons, titles, bytes or Auth tokens in browser storage.

Actual SQL-to-Dart original/status receipts pass; terminal/status recovery implemented

items.title: Full upload decoding safety
items.local_acceptance: Implement full bounded image/PDF validation or a validated sandbox with page/object/animation/decompression limits. Test corrupt/spoofed/polyglot/page-heavy/expansion inputs before vendor calls.

items.title: Durable concurrent upload/extraction limits
items.local_acceptance: Implement actor/global concurrent and resource/cost reservations with idempotent recovery, timeouts, exhaustion, abuse and multiple-worker local tests.

items.title: Trusted XLSX transformation
items.local_acceptance: Verify original workbook bytes against derived TSV using a trusted bounded parser. Reject inconsistent or substituted content and test workbook expansion, malformed relationships and row/cell limits.

items.title: Import/export and sensitive-action protection
items.local_acceptance: Test formula injection, row/resource bounds, data minimization, redaction, permission denial, accountable reasons and durable import/export/reveal/grant/retry audit.

items.title: Multilingual/adversarial evaluation tooling

items.title: Generated-dataset query benchmarks
items.local_acceptance: Benchmark realistic generated volumes, all sorts/scopes/page depths and concurrent paging. Correct ordering, excessive scanning, whole-history reconstruction, aggregation growth and queue-shrink behavior.

items.title: Identity/totals/money/ID/date correctness
items.local_acceptance: Audit every consumer and modern/legacy RPC/cache/input path for immutable identity, collision/forgery denial, complete versus partial/absent/stale/zero totals, exact integer bounds, aliases, IDs and valid calendar/timezone behavior.

items.title: Cache/reconnect/session isolation
